comparison.objective: Rotate an off-balance table 90 degrees and lock it with a pin; candidate fractures and collects insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterholding an unstable rotary load while aligning and dropping a lock pin versus coaxial mandrel holding, impact delivery, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Table indexed 90 degrees and pin engaged before release versus four completed fractures and recovered tangs with coils fixed.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and bimanual holding are generic; load indexing and pin locking test a different ability.
